projectContext: Sprint 27 continues testing infrastructure maturity after Sprint 26 completed bulk marker assignment (10,957 markers), marker-based CI workflow, fixture adoption enforcement, benchmark baseline tracking, test isolation auditing, agent healer coverage, matching strategy coverage, mock patterns documentation, helper adoption measurement, and lint workflow fixes. This sprint focuses on: (1) completing marker assignment for remaining ~292 unmarked tests, (2) converting skipped integration tests to proper conditional tests, (3) adding mutation testing foundation with mutmut, (4) improving test parallelization with xdist optimization, (5) adding property-based testing with hypothesis for core algorithms, (6) creating test data generators for edge cases, (7) adding test performance profiling and slow test optimization, and (8) improving test coverage for compilation module (currently at 84%, target 85%).
